decisions.rationale: Permanent fix for Node 20.19+ loadESMFromCJS: compiled dist/ is CJS, Strapi require() never triggers ESM parsing, no more cascading named-import failures from lodash/fs-extra/etc.

decisions.decision: Keep fix-lodash-fp.js for Strapi upstream bugs
decisions.rationale: @strapi/core 5.37.1 own .mjs files have named imports from lodash/fp and fs-extra — these are Strapi bugs unrelated to our tsconfig. The patch remains necessary until upstream fixes.
512M container limit caused OOM during Strapi startup (~249MB heap used). Stable at ~323MB with 1G limit.
All workflow triggers were on master but active branch is main — CI/CD was never auto-triggering on any push to main. Critical discovery.

decisions.decision: cms-ts-compile CI gate: tsc --noEmit + module format validation
decisions.rationale: Would have caught the module:ESNext misconfiguration in 3 minutes instead of 10 hours of manual debugging.
Security: CMS only accessible via Docker internal network or Traefik. Smoke tests must use docker exec or Traefik URL.

next_action: Run smoke test via docker exec on VPS. See .continue-here.md <next_action> section for exact command. Then tasks 2+3 (smoke + SUMMARY).
context_notes: Session 2026-03-23 afternoon. 11 Docker builds total. Root cause found session 2 (tsconfig ESNext). CI/CD audit revealed master/main split-brain — all automated workflows were broken.
